Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray shows discrete areas of hypotransparency (opacities) in the upper zones of both hemithoraces, with the opacity on the right side being visibly larger and more pronounced than on the left. This asymmetry and extent suggest a progression or worsening of the previously diagnosed right-sided pneumonia rather than a symmetric pattern typical of chemical pneumonitis or an isolated finding.
